notes.title: Hamster Maze - cuteness overload!
notes.notes:
You may know us as the caterers of more hardcore tastes, the ones revolving around hacking and slashing, dicing and slicing, fighting for survival, but we also have a softer side that has just been manifested as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/41028947]We Dig Games[/url] – the makers of an extremely cute and laid-back game by the name of Hamster Maze. Follow the link and have a look at the game, witness warmth and care that is the core of this new experience – you won’t regret it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1442670/Hamster_Maze/

notes.title: Mass Creation Bundle!
notes.notes:
[i][u][b]Hello! [/b][/u][/i]
It's been a while since we announce anything, but we were working on our newest game! 
If you didn't check it out, we've got you covered: it's a beat'em'up, called [b]Shing![/b] and you guys can check it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1103730/Shing/]HERE[/url]!

[b]But wait! There is more!  [/b]
What is even more awesome - we created a special bundle with all our games available on Steam with a [b]33% discount[/b]. 

And if you already own one of our games from the bundle, you can buy the rest and it still will be 33% cheaper! How cool is that? 

You can check the bundle below: 
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16286/Mass_Creation_Bundle/

notes.title: Free week with Draw Slasher!
notes.notes:
Christmas is almost here and we’ve been thinking about some kind of present for our players. And what could be better than a freebie? We would like to give you all a free copy of Draw Slasher, both as a gift and in preparation for the upcoming [b]Shing![/b] 
The game will be available free on Steam for a week, but the offer is limited [b](13.12.2019 - 20.12.2019)[/b]! So be quick!

notes.title: Small patch released
notes.notes:
Hello Players,

We've released a small patch making the cursor 'stay' within the screen borders. Additionally, on touchscreen devices pressing Alt+C will hide the cursor. It's around 5MB, so you'll be back in the game in no time!

Enjoy the slashing time!

Ninjas@Mass Creation
